svg.title: Figure S3
svg.desc: SHMtrace outputs: a project run takes reads and AID-null controls and writes a report, figures, tables and the full result; its 26 figures are grouped by six questions, each with an example from a J_H4 nanopore run and a note on how to read it.

tspan.tspan: Examples redrawn from one run (JH4 intron, nanopore, 500 reads per mouse):

tspan.tspan: One dot per animal (open: none found); bars are
geometric means. The test counts each animal
once, however many reads it gave.
frequency counts a clone's mutations in
every read; unique density counts them once.
